title: Dabaru
desc: The film follows the story of Indian Chess Grandmaster Surya Shekhar Ganguly. It showcases his journey from the slums of North Calcutta to his victory in the 1998 Commonwealth Chess Championship.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Ostad
desc: Sanjay and Mili, two college goers, fall in love with each other. Their fathers are business rivals and this creates various problems in their lives.

title: Guru Dakshina
desc: Jayant, an aspiring singer, finds his way to the city in order to make it big. Soon, he garners accolades for his performances and eventually falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless businessman.

title: Pita Maata Santan
desc: Shikha and Pradeep's marital bliss is shattered when he takes their daughter, Jaya, away. A few years later, fate brings them face to face when Jaya becomes employed in Shikha's company.

title: Sukh Dukher Sansar
desc: Amar, the eldest of four, struggles to provide a better life to his younger siblings. However, things take a turn for the worse when his younger sister meets with an accident and is visually impaired.

title: Mejo Bou
desc: Barun's father forces him to marry Sampa, a colleague from a middle-class background. After the marriage, Barun creates problems for his new wife and damages her reputation.
